name: feedback-popover
title: Feedback Popover
description: A small dark pill asks 'Like our service?' with four mood faces. Picking one expands it into a comment box with Submit, then flashes a check and a thank-you message.
use: You want a lightweight inline way to collect a rating and one comment without opening a full form.
avoid: Feedback needs several fields or real validation; this is one comment box with a mock submit.
a11y: The icon-only mood buttons have no accessible names, and nothing announces the opened form or success. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow dark rounded pill holding the question and four tiny face icons. After a mood is chosen it grows into a taller dark card with a bordered text area at the top, a white Submit button at the bottom right, and later a blue check circle.
behaves: Clicking a face expands the pill into a form with a smooth height animation and turns that icon blue. Submit swaps the button for a spinner, then the card shows a check and two short thank-you lines before resetting.
customise: The question, mood icons and placeholder are written in the source, and Submit runs a fake one-second delay. Colours and the expanded size come from classes you would edit.
weight: light: A few nodes with small layout and opacity animations; the request is only a one-second timer.
